name: Rainbow Robotics
summary: Rainbow Robotics was founded by KAIST researchers who built the HUBO biped, and now makes collaborative robots and the RB-Y1 mobile manipulator. Samsung Electronics became its largest shareholder in 2025.
funding: Samsung Electronics raised its stake from 14.7% to 35% to become the largest shareholder.

sources.title: Samsung increases stake in Rainbow Robotics, establishes Future Robotics Office
